pulse.text: **Kimi K3's open weights land tonight** — Moonshot's 2.8T-parameter flagship, the largest open-weight release ever attempted, is scheduled for 8pm ET (Jul 27 00:00 UTC) under a modified MIT license, and the moonshotai Hugging Face org still had no K3 repo as of 3am. Nothing shipped in the last twelve hours: Claude Opus 5 holds sole #1 at **61** on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1 over Fable 5 (60), GPT-5.6 Sol (59) and Kimi K3 (57), and Polymarket's July best-model market is unmoved at **99.4% Anthropic**. The cleanest market signal is that frontier Elo genuinely advanced this month — Polymarket's Arena ladder shifted a full rung, with **1500+ locking at 100%** and the old 89% migrating up to the 1510 threshold — while Google's next Gemini Pro firmed to **31% by Aug 7** (from 22%, still 85% by Aug 31) and IMO gold softened to 71% from 77% on thin volume. Two additions this sweep: **Sakana AI's Fugu-Cyber**, a closed, application-gated cybersecurity orchestration endpoint claiming 86.9% on CyberGym with no published methodology, and ByteDance's Seed 2.1 Pro flipping preview to generally available. Next up: the weights drop tonight, and Manifold prices **63%** that DeepSeek ships something of its own before Jul 31.
